```artifact
Feature: Services within and around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario Outline: Services are offered within a radius of 25 sqkm
    Given the hospital location is at coordinates (13.0827, 77.5815)
    And the patient's location is at coordinates <patient_coordinates>
    When the system checks the patient's eligibility for services
    Then the system should <result> the patient's eligibility for services
    Examples:
      | patient_coordinates | result         |
      | 13.0827, 77.5815    | confirm        |
      | 13.0827, 77.5816    | confirm        |
      | 13.0827, 77.5817    | deny           |

  Scenario Outline: Patients can register and apply for appointments within the specified zone
    Given the patient's pincode is <patient_pincode>
    And the system has the following authorized pincodes: <authorized_pincode>
    When the patient attempts to register for an appointment
    Then the system should <result> the registration
    Examples:
      | patient_pincode | authorized_pincode | result         |
      | 560029          | 560029, 560030     | confirm        |
      | 560031          | 560029, 560030     | deny           |

  Scenario Outline: There is 1 Authorized Chemist per Pincode
    Given the patient's pincode is <patient_pincode>
    And the system has the following authorized chemists: <authorized_chemist>
    When the system checks for an authorized chemist
    Then the system should <result> the availability of an authorized chemist
    Examples:
      | patient_pincode | authorized_chemist | result         |
      | 560029          | 560029:ChemistA    | confirm        |
      | 560030          | 560029:ChemistA    | deny           |

  Scenario Outline: Prescription requests are routed to the Chemist based on Pincode
    Given the patient's pincode is <patient_pincode>
    And the chemist's pincode is <chemist_pincode>
    When the system routes a prescription request
    Then the system should <result> the routing of the prescription request
    Examples:
      | patient_pincode | chemist_pincode | result         |
      | 560029          | 560029          | confirm        |
      | 560029          | 560030          | deny           |

  Scenario Outline: Chemists deliver medicines through Offline delivery and collect payments
    Given the chemist has received a prescription request
    And the chemist's pincode matches the patient's pincode
    When the chemist delivers the medicines
    Then the system should <result> the delivery status
    Examples:
      | result         |
      | confirm        |

  Scenario Outline: Chemists mark the Prescription on completion of delivery
    Given the chemist has delivered the medicines
    When the chemist marks the prescription as delivered
    Then the system should <result> the prescription status
    Examples:
      | result         |
      | confirm        |

  Scenario Outline: There is 1 Authorized Laboratory per Pincode or for the entire Zone
    Given the patient's pincode is <patient_pincode>
    And the system has the following authorized laboratories: <authorized_laboratory>
    When the system checks for an authorized laboratory
    Then the system should <result> the availability of an authorized laboratory
    Examples:
      | patient_pincode | authorized_laboratory | result         |
      | 560029          | 560029:LaboratoryA    | confirm        |
      | 560030          | 560029:LaboratoryA    | deny           |
```
